system: WinIOS Virtual Display, Window Server, Compositor & Touch Input Subsystem
target_research_profile: iPhone 15 (iPhone15,4 / D37AP / Apple A16 Bionic T8120)

window_server_capabilities.damage_tracking: Bounding Box Dirty Rect Tracking & Partial Redraw
window_server_capabilities.frame_scheduler: Deterministic Virtual Clock Frame Scheduler (60 / 120 FPS)
window_server_capabilities.access_control: PID-based ownership validation with kernel privilege override

input_subsystem_capabilities.queue_architecture: Bounded FIFO ring buffer (256 events, oldest overwrite on overflow)
input_subsystem_capabilities.routing_policy: Frontmost window hit-testing with contact capture and window-local coordinate translation

syscall_interface_category_c.abi_convention: X16 = Syscall Number, X0..X5 = Arguments, X0 = Return Code / Return Value

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_window_create
syscalls.description: Create application window and display surface

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_window_destroy
syscalls.description: Destroy window and release allocated surfaces

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_surface_update
syscalls.description: Upload pixel buffer to process display surface

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_surface_present
syscalls.description: Mark surface dirty and schedule compositor frame

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_poll_event
syscalls.description: Retrieve next input event from process queue (window-local coordinates)

syscalls.name: SYS_winios_surface_fill
syscalls.description: Fill rectangle on surface with 32-bit color

guest_shell.role: Home screen shell with app launcher icons
